name: KiloNeRF
definition: A method that adopts a teacher-student training paradigm where a standard NeRF is trained first, and its knowledge is distilled into a set of lightweight MLPs arranged in a 3D grid.
summary: KiloNeRF accelerates Neural Radiance Fields by replacing a single large network with thousands of independent, lightweight MLPs, each responsible for a small 3D grid cell, achieving up to 2000-fold speedup through knowledge distillation.
